list.title: Vouchers
list.intro: The Owner's discounts, for the cashiers of every outlet or some. Their times are in WIB.
list.empty: No vouchers yet. Create the first one.

outletList.title: Vouchers
outletList.intro: The vouchers this outlet's cashiers can take. Only the Owner creates and changes them.

form.codeHint: 3–20 letters and digits, which the cashier types. Kept in capitals.
form.nameHint: Optional, seen in the admin only.
form.percentHint: Of the subtotal, before the service charge and the tax.
form.amountHint: Rupiah, never more than the subtotal.
form.quotaHint: In every outlet together. A voided sale gives its use back.
form.quotaUsedHint: Used already: the uses can only grow.
form.periodHint: The start and the expiry are in WIB for every outlet.
form.startHint: Leave it empty to start at once.
form.expiryUsedHint: Used already: the expiry can only move later.
form.activeHint: Cashiers can take it once its period starts. It can be deactivated at any time.
form.usedNotice: This voucher has been used, so its code and type are locked, its uses can only grow, and its expiry can only move later.

create.title: Create a voucher
create.intro: The cashier takes it by typing its code, one voucher per sale.

detail.activeBody: This voucher is active: cashiers can take it during its period, until its uses run out.
detail.inactiveBody: This voucher is inactive: cashiers can't take it. Its history stays.
detail.deactivateBody: From the next sale on, cashiers can't take this voucher. You can activate it again.
detail.activateBody: Cashiers can take it again during its period, until its uses run out.
detail.deleteBody: No sale has used this voucher. Once it's deleted, another voucher can have its code.
detail.usedCantDelete: A voucher that has been used can't be deleted: its sales still name it. Deactivate it instead.

redemptions.title: Uses
redemptions.empty: No sale has used this voucher yet.
